theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The theme tops the momentum rank (2.225), is eligible under the absolute-trend gate, and shows trend health (hurst_tag 'trend') with a durability_bar of 0.48 and no crowding flag (crowded false, crowding_z 0.86). The trend-gate leg supports staying with the leader rather than fading it; momentum rank is used only as a focus lens, not a return forecast.
